description: Export artboards as PNG files, one per artboard, at a scale (100 = 72 ppi, 300 = 216 ppi)

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

matteColor.description: Blend edges (and, with transparent false, the background) against this colour, #RRGGBB

maxHeight.description: Fit each image within this height in pixels, instead of scale

maxWidth.description: Fit each image within this width in pixels, instead of scale

prefix.description: File name prefix. Default the document name

saveAsHtml.description: Also write an HTML page showing each image. Default false

name: export_png
title: Export PNG
